receiver_research_conclusion: Keep K331 as the leading functional candidate: official AKK-hosted media closes the application circuit, complete 14-pin function and 24-channel truth table. The official Sinopine SP331RX manual now controls the matching 331RX family's nominal 28.7 x 23.1 mm XY, 2.54-mm contact pitch and 1.4-mm edge offset, but does not formally prove that the supplied AKK K331 is the same production identity and omits maximum Z/tolerances, recommended land/paste, packaging and reflow. AWM666V RX remains the controlled contingency because its exact body, recommended land pattern, 210-mA maximum and CVBS/RSSI/control interface fit the existing reserve, but its seven-channel 5725-5875-MHz coverage and absent public JLCPCB route are material degradations. JLCPCB confirmed no Parts Library, Global Sourcing or direct replacement route and accepts genuine AKK supply through Consigned Parts. Wait for AKK or Sinopine to close only the narrowed production-identity/assembly package; public RTC6715/RX5808 cards and a custom bare-IC design still do not solve supply or RF risk.
